risk_note: RV2 (admin console read-only accounts). GET /admin/v1/admins (page / page_size 1..200) and GET /admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}, x-auth super enforced by the F1-06k admin token check (10403 admin_permission_denied); reads app.admin_users / admin_permissions through couli_app on the primary, ordered by created_at then id, same app_id only; returns admin_id, username, is_super, status, totp_bound, verify_phone_masked (BR-ID-33), locked_until (null when not locked by the injected Clock) and permissions ([] for a super admin); never returns password hashes, TOTP secrets or full phone numbers; read-only, no audit. Two contract operations leave planned. Rebuilt on main after F1-06l (#387); BR-ID-33 masking and the verify-phone decryption context are shared with step-up-policy. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
